newsitem.title: USA: CORPORATEFAMILY IPO OF 2.35 MLN SHRS AT $10/SHR.
newsitem.headline: CORPORATEFAMILY IPO OF 2.35 MLN SHRS AT $10/SHR.

text.p: CorporateFamily Solutions Inc CFAM.O said Wednesday it launched an initial public offering of 2.35 million common shares at $10 per share.
The company said that of the total, it offered 1.35 million shares while selling shareholders offered 1.0 million.

The company, which provides a range of management and consulting services for employers, said net proceeds from the offering would be used to repay debt and for working capital, and general corporate purposes, including possible acquisitions.

It said Montgomery Securities and J.C. Bradford & Co. are the managing underwriters of the offering. It granted the underwriters an over-allotment option to purchase up to 352,500 additional shares, it said.

The company provides services to employers such as workplace child care, education and other family support programs. It currently manages 87 employer-sponsored family centers for 65 corporate clients in 27 states.
